item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nimport work\\n\\nschema=json.loads(Path('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json').read_text())\\npolicy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nrequests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\nreport=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nactual=[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nassert actual==report\\nfor item in report:\\n    assert set(item)==set(schema['required'])=={'needs_review','changed'}\\n    assert isinstance(item['needs_review'],bool)\\n    assert isinstance(item['changed'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in item['changed'])\\n\\nprobes=[\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','meta':{'x':1,'y':2}}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'meta':{'y':2,'x':1},'kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['missing','created','deleted'],'saved':{'deleted':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'created':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['created','deleted']}),\\n ({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'y':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':false,'changed':[]})\\n]\\nfor request,p,expected in probes:\\n    old=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(p))\\n    assert work.evaluate(request,p)==expected\\n    assert (request,p)==old\\nprint('report/schema check passed; independent probes passed:',len(probes))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
